title: Cross-Org All-Hands — action map and highlights (11 Mar 2026)
content:
Date: 2026-03-11
Present: ~320 (all eng + product leads), recording uploaded to #announcements, Q&A thread open in Slack
Facilitator: Maya Chen (Platform Eng)
notes:
TL;DR:
- Quick wins: platform autoscaler patch reduced tail latency spikes by ~18% in Canary.
- Near-term focus: (1) Complete Dedicated autoscaling GA checklist, (2) Roll forward new KV cache eviction policy to staging, (3) Finalize private deployment onboarding playbook.
- Asks from org: prioritize infra cost telemetry (billing-by-model) and a small cross-team task force for model-variant fallback policies.

Metrics snapshot (week over week):
- 95th token latency (hosted): 210ms -> 175ms (canary hosts)
- Request rate p95: +11% WoW (product-driven spike)
- Cost per 1k tokens (optimized routes): -7% after batching tweaks
- Incidents: 1 Sev-2 (rapid autoscaler oscillation, mitigated by cooldown increase)

Highlights by area:
- Serving Runtime (Benji):
  * Kernel selector improvements landed in PR #1287; microbenchmarks show 6–12% gen throughput gains for 8k and above sequences.
  * Work in progress: automated kernel fallbacks for quantized-op mismatches (spike cause in last regression).
  * Blocker: we need an L0 perf test infra node with A100->H100 parity to validate mixed-precision behaviors.

- Platform & Autoscale (Maya):
  * Canary autoscaler patch (INF-4231) reduced tail by 18% by smoothing scale-in.
  * Next: add scheduled scale-up windows for nightly retrains to avoid cold starts.
  * Action: finalize GA checklist (security review + SLA language) — see action item 2.

- Private Deployments & Onboarding (Priya):
  * Pilot customer onboarding: first private deployment completed in NZ region; latency/SLO feedback positive.
  * Need: a one-page checklist for SOC2 customers describing network/KMS expectations.

- Console & Observability (Sofia):
  * Token-level cost drilldowns prototype demoed; product requests more granular attribution (by model + route).
  * TODO: integrate cost signals into rollout guardrails (early-warning).

Open questions raised during Q&A (summarized):
- How aggressive should automated fallbacks be vs. preserving response quality? (Product & Applied ML loop needed)
- Request from Sales: an expedited “Dedicated quickstart” for small-enterprise customers — what’s minimum viable scope?
- Can we ship the eviction policy change without an extended soak in staging? (SRE asks for 48h extra soak)

Decisions made on call:
- Autoscaler cooldown increase will ship to production in the next maintenance window; rollback plan exists. (Owner: Maya; JIRA INF-4231)
- Create a 2-week cross-team spike to prototype billing-by-model telemetry. (Owners: Sofia, Alex)
- For Private GA, postpone “non-essential” UI polish until after compliance signoff; ship core onboarding docs first.

Action items (owner / due date / ticket):
1) Perf infra parity node: provision one H100-equivalent staging node and run L0 perf jobs. Owner: Benji Park; Due: 2026-03-18; Ticket: INF-4302.
2) Dedicated GA checklist: compile security, SLA, docs, and runbook. Owner: Maya Chen; Due: 2026-03-25; Ticket: DOCS-212.
3) Billing telemetry spike: prototype ingest pipeline for model-tagged token events. Owners: Sofia Martinez, Alex Rios; Due: 2026-04-01; Ticket: METRICS-1107.
4) KV cache eviction soak: extend staging soak by 48h and capture P99/P95 deltas. Owner: Priya Nair; Due: 2026-03-16; Ticket: RUNTIME-889.
5) Dedicated quickstart scope doc: draft a trimmed onboarding checklist for small-mid enterprise. Owner: Drew Holt (solutions); Due: 2026-03-22; Linked: confluence quickstart stub.

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: rolling kv eviction without soak could regress tail latency under heavy context churn. Mitigation: 48h soak + Canary traffic ramp + metric guardrails (P99 token latency spike threshold).
- Risk: billing-by-model telemetry adds cardinality and storage costs. Mitigation: sample at 1% initially, iterate on sampling strategy.

Notes to self / follow-ups (informal):
- Need clearer owner mapping for rollout guardrails — create a small RACI with SRE/product/rte.
- Consider a short “what changed” email to customers for Dedicated GA timeline to reduce expectational drift.

Q&A highlights (selected):
Q: Will Dedicated GA impact hosted customers?
A: No direct impact; capacity-isolated pools. We will surface any rate limits ahead of time.
Q: How will model fallbacks affect prompt latency?
A: Fallback decisions will consider both latency and semantic distance; we’ll put a 2-level policy (soft fallback with async re-score, hard fallback if SLO breached).

Attachments / reference links:
- Canary autoscaler PR: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/342
- INF-4231 incident playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/INF-4231-playbook
- Draft Private GA onboarding checklist: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/PRIVATE-GA-PLAYBOOK

Next all-hands: tentative 2026-03-25; suggestion: make next meeting shorter (30 min) and focus on three measurable updates (autoscale, billing telemetry, Private GA).
